functions.name: HasObjects
functions.signature: HasObjects(In Element List, In Required Class)
functions.docs: Test whether there are any objects in the given list of elements.

functions.name: CountObjects
functions.signature: CountObjects(In Element List, In Required Class)
functions.docs: Count the number of objects in the given list of elements.

functions.name: ForEachObject
functions.signature: ForEachObject(In Element List, In Callback, In Required Class)
functions.docs:
Enumerate the objects from the given list of elements.
@note Return true from the callback to continue enumeration.

functions.name: GetObjects
functions.signature: GetObjects(In Element List, In Required Class)
functions.docs: Get the array of objects from the given list of elements.

functions.name: GetTopObject
functions.signature: GetTopObject(In Element List, In Required Class)
functions.docs: Get the first object of the given type from the given list of elements.

functions.name: GetBottomObject
functions.signature: GetBottomObject(In Element List, In Required Class)
functions.docs: Get the last object of the given type from the given list of elements.

functions.name: HasObjectsOfExactClass
functions.docs: Test if there are any objects of the exact class in the given list of elements (a quick test using the class counter, skipping derived types).

functions.name: CountObjectsOfExactClass
functions.docs: Count the number of objects of the exact class in the given list of elements (a quick test using the class counter, skipping derived types).

functions.name: ForEachObjectClass
functions.docs:
Enumerate the classes of the objects in the given list of elements.
@note Return true from the callback to continue enumeration.
